segments.prompt: One continuous 2D hand-drawn cinematic medium-full shot in the existing mechanical airport. Keep exactly one LLL-MAIN-001 with the exact established face, long red hair, red-white-black mechanical armor, cyan functional accents, two mechanical claw feet and exactly one long segmented mechanical dragon tail. She watches an existing guidance-light region ahead, leans forward with competitive impatience, tightens her tail for balance, and before the environmental state fully settles she takes one premature step forward. At the end, the existing guidance lighting begins to change in direct response. Preserve the scene identity and palette; restrained camera, no cut.

Continue directly from the previous final state. The existing guidance-light relationship in the same mechanical airport reorganizes once as a direct consequence of her premature step. She brakes sharply but with controlled animation: head and shoulders stop first, the single tail counterbalances, the stepping foot stabilizes. She stares at the changed route and realizes her action triggered it. End with her still leaning forward but refusing to take another step. Same character, same place, same axis, no cut.

Continue from the held forward-leaning pose. Her competitive expression hardens. She makes a second, more obvious forward commitment, lifting one mechanical claw foot with slightly greater confidence. Before she can complete the move, the existing guidance state responds early again, making the route harder to read. She is forced to freeze in an awkward half-step, then finally reins in her momentum. Keep motion compact and readable, same environment and spatial axis.

Continue from the awkward half-step. She returns the lifted foot to a stable stance and stops trying to overpower the situation. With the body nearly still, only the tip of her single long tail and one claw foot make a tiny sideways test. The existing environmental guidance responds once in the same direction. Her eyes change from irritation to a quiet realization: she now understands the response pattern. Finish on a restrained knowing expression, body steady.

Continue from the moment of realization. She deliberately commits her gaze, shoulders and lifted claw foot toward a false direction, making the feint clearly readable. Wait for the existing guidance state to respond toward that false commitment. Then the tip of her single tail flicks toward the true lateral direction first, and the same lifted claw foot lands once sideways rather than forward. Her torso follows only enough to settle over the new foot. Compact, cunning, behavior-driven motion; same mechanical airport, no new objects.

Continue directly from the sideways landing. She completes one small body turn into a stable position, her single mechanical tail opens to balance, and the existing guidance state settles back into a stable configuration. She looks back once toward the direction she had tried to force earlier, gives a restrained triumphant half-smile, and becomes completely still. End on a clean readable final pose suitable for the end of a one-minute sequence. Same identity, scene family, palette and 2D linework.

master_style_prompt: 2D hand-drawn cinematic animation, clear linework and flat/light wash shading, preserve exact LLL-MAIN-001 identity and mechanical-airport palette, restrained camera, readable silhouette, no glossy 3D. Single continuous character performance across all segments.
